description: This file defines the CreditBureauData class, a data transfer object used within the Fineract project to represent credit bureau information. It employs Lombok annotations for boilerplate code reduction and provides a static factory method for instantiation.

classes.name: CreditBureauData
classes.description: A data container class for credit bureau information, including identifiers, names, country, product details, summary, and implementation key, with chainable setters and a static factory method.

methods.description: Static factory method to create a new CreditBureauData instance with specified properties.
